The Cisco CAB-C15-CBN Power Cord is a premium-grade 250V 13A cabinet jumper cable, built for robust power connectivity in server rooms, data centers, and enterprise network cabinets. It features IEC C14 to C15 connectors for seamless integration with Cisco and other compatible equipment. Ideal for high-load, mission-critical environments where safety and uptime matter.

Now available in Bangladesh with genuine quality, fast shipping, and expert support from dcores.net.

Key Features:

  • Voltage Rating: 250V AC
  • Current Rating: 13 Amps
  • Connector Type: IEC C14 (Plug) to IEC C15 (Socket)
  • Application: Server racks, UPS, PDUs, data centers
  • Durable & heat-resistant cable jacket
  • Optimized for Cisco enterprise devices
  • Certified for safety and reliability
